program='''def transform(grid):
    inner = [row[1:] for row in grid[1:]]
    n = len(inner)
    r = [row[0] for row in grid[1:]].index(2)
    c = grid[0][1:].index(2)
    rs = r if r < n / 2 else n - r
    cs = c if c < n / 2 else n - c
    start_r = n - rs if r < n / 2 else rs
    start_c = n - cs if c < n / 2 else cs
    rows = inner[start_r:] + inner[:start_r]
    return [row[start_c:] + row[:start_c] for row in rows]
'''
